documents.title: Capital of France
documents.text: Paris is the official capital and most populous city of France, located along the Seine River in the north-central part of the country.

documents.title: Paris Overview
documents.text: Paris is the capital of France and serves as the nation major political, cultural, and commercial center.

documents.title: Speed of Light in Vacuum
documents.text: The speed of light in vacuum is an exact universal physical constant defined as 299,792,458 metres per second.
documents.source: International Bureau of Weights and Measures

documents.title: Photosynthesis Fundamentals
documents.text: Photosynthesis is the biochemical process by which green plants, algae, and cyanobacteria convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose, releasing oxygen gas as a byproduct.

documents.title: Light Speed Physical Constant
documents.text: The speed of light in vacuum is an exact universal physical constant defined as 299,792,458 metres per second.

documents.title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
documents.text: Apollo 11 was the American spaceflight that first landed humans on the Moon on July 20, 1969, with astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin.

documents.title: Signing of the United States Declaration of Independence
documents.text: The United States Declaration of Independence was formally adopted by the Second Continental Congress on July 4, 1776, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

documents.title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
documents.text: The Berlin Wall, which divided East and West Berlin during the Cold War, was opened on November 9, 1989, paving the way for German reunification.

documents.title: Python Programming Language Release
documents.text: Python is a high-level, general-purpose programming language conceived in the late 1980s by Guido van Rossum and first released in 1991.

documents.title: World Wide Web Invention
documents.text: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN, developing the first web browser and web server protocols.

documents.title: Discovery of Penicillin
documents.text: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in September 1928 at St Mary Hospital in London after observing antibacterial properties in Penicillium notatum mold.

documents.title: Jupiter Planetary Characteristics
documents.text: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System, with a mass more than two and a half times that of all the other planets combined.

documents.title: William Shakespeare Playwright
documents.text: William Shakespeare was an English playwright, poet, and actor, widely regarded as the greatest writer in the English language, born in Stratford-upon-Avon in 1564.
